levels.L0: the reference surface remeshed isotropically at 3.5 mm target edge, vertices kept within 0.2 mm of the reference, then Gmsh HXT tetrahedra up to 5 mm; quadratic displacement (P2) on straight tetrahedra
levels.L1: L0 with every zone remeshed at 1.75 mm: a sphere of 12 mm radius about each studied location
levels.L2: L1 with a sphere of 6 mm radius about each studied location remeshed at 0.875 mm
levels.zones: the studied locations are chosen on L0 before L1 and L2 exist, by the rule below; L1 and L2 refine all of them at once, so every case of every candidate is read on the same three meshes

studied_locations.stress: von Mises of the vertex stress: the six components averaged at each vertex over the tetrahedra that share it, weighted by volume
studied_locations.per_case: for the cold assembly (one set: its stresses do not depend on the alloy) and for the hot firing of each candidate: the vertex of highest von Mises stress, then the highest vertex farther than 15 mm from every location already taken, three times
studied_locations.zones: the union of all these locations; two locations closer than 15 mm share one zone
studied_locations.peak_at_a_location: the highest vertex von Mises stress within 3 mm of the location, on each level

status.increments: d01 = P1 - P0 and d12 = P2 - P1, with P0, P1, P2 the peaks at the location on L0, L1, L2
status.converged: |d12| <= 0.05 P2 and |d12| <= 0.5 |d01| (a smooth peak with an error of order h^2 or h gives 0.25 or 0.5); the reported value is P2
status.diverging: d01 > 0 and d12 > 0 and d12 >= 0.7 d01: the peak keeps rising at least as fast as a weak singularity would; it is reported as a singular corner and never as a stress
status.not_converged: anything else; the reported value is P2, marked 'at most' for a margin if the peak was still rising (d12 > 0)
status.slope: the log-log slope log(P2 / P1) / log 2 is recorded for each location (the WE43 impeller root of 2026-10-28 rose with 0.295)
status.geometry_note: every edge of the mechanical body is rounded by the declared Gaussian of 0.5 mm (H16); no corner radius of the head is acquired. A corner whose rounding the finest level does not resolve (h about 0.26 r for a blend of radius r) can rise on every level: such a peak is a property of the declared rounding, not of the head

solver_witness.cases: thick cylinder under internal pressure (Lame, plane strain), its uniform heating between fixed end planes, a free block with a linear temperature (no stress); P2 tetrahedra, the same code path as the head
solver_witness.acceptance: hoop stress at the bore within 2 % of the closed form on average, radial displacement within 1 %, axial stress of the heated ring within 1 %, largest von Mises of the free block below 0.1 % of E alpha dT; the same results on 1 and 4 processes within 1e-6 relative

fatigue.cycle: the firing cycle between hot_assembled and hot_firing (params/mechanical-load-case.json)
fatigue.amplitude: von Mises of half the stress-range tensor
fatigue.mean: von Mises of the mean tensor with the sign of its first invariant
fatigue.criterion: Goodman: factor n = 1 / (amplitude / S_a(T) + max(mean, 0) / S_u(T)), with S_a the fully reversed fatigue amplitude at the location's temperature and S_u the tensile strength at that temperature, both read by straight lines between published temperatures
fatigue.duty: no life is stated: the factor compares the cycle with the fatigue strength at the source's run-out (2e6 or 1e7 cycles), which is shorter than or near the hypothesis duty of 5.76e6 cycles (H21)
fatigue.elastic_validity: where the hot mean stress exceeds the hot yield, the elastic mean is not a stress the alloy can hold: the factor is reported with that flag
fatigue.start_stop: elastic shakedown is possible only if the von Mises range from cold assembly to hot firing does not exceed the room-temperature yield plus the yield at the location's temperature (a Melan-type screen); otherwise every start-stop cycle yields again, which is low-cycle and thermo-mechanical fatigue, and no life is stated without strain-life data at temperature
